title: Common App logs
description:
Goal
Enable clients to emit common app events that power product analytics and operational metrics. Aggregate these into a new DynamoDB table named 'ActivityStatistics', and expose the metrics via admin-only endpoints for dashboarding.

Storage and scope
- Raw events: existing 'UserAppLogs' (AppLogModel) and 'ActivityLog' remain the sources of truth.
- Aggregates: new DynamoDB table 'ActivityStatistics' stores precomputed metrics by period.
- Periods: daily and weekly (UTC), computed via scheduled jobs.
- Access: metrics are only exposed via 'AdminController'/'AdminService'. No public statistics endpoints.

Schema and constraints
- 'ActivityStatistics' attributes: id, metricKey, periodGranularity ('daily'|'weekly'), periodStart (ISO UTC), periodEnd (ISO UTC), valueNumber (numeric), details (map), createdAt, updatedAt.
- Keys: HASH id (deterministic: '<metricKey>#<granularity>#<periodStartISO>'), GSI 'by-metricKey-periodStart'.
- No 'dimensions' or 'source_version'. Use standard createdAt/updatedAt from BaseIdModel.

Event taxonomy for clients
- Clients emit events to existing app logging using 'eventName' and 'properties'. We will export 'AppEventName' enum for stable names:
  - session_start, session_end, prompt_shown, prompt_accepted, prompt_ignored
  - journal_started, journal_completed, journal_canceled, journal_type_selected
  - voice_recording_started, voice_recording_canceled, voice_recording_completed
  - voice_note_available, voice_note_played
  - daily_action_suggested, daily_action_completed, micro_action_suggested, micro_action_completed
  - nudge_sent, nudge_opened
  - onboarding_step_completed, onboarding_completed
  - latency_measured, error

Metrics computed (v1)
- Product engagement: daily active users (DAU), weekly active users (WAU), sessions per user, average session length, prompt acceptance rate, nudge open rate, daily action completion rate.
- Voice journal: recordings count, average recording length, recording drop-off and completion rates, journal completion rate.
- Flow/drop-off: onboarding completion rate, prompt accept/ignore rates.
- Operational: WhatsApp delivery/failed rates, system errors count.

Aggregation approach
- Daily job (00:15 UTC) computes previous day; weekly job (Mon 01:00 UTC) computes previous week.
- Sessionization: new session after 30 minutes of inactivity when explicit events are absent; prefer explicit 'session_start'/'session_end' when present.
- Idempotent upserts using deterministic ids allow safe recomputation and backfills.

Admin exposure
- Admin-only endpoints under '/admin/statistics':
  - GET metrics (list metric keys and descriptions)
  - GET series (metricKey, from, to, granularity, pagination)
  - GET snapshot (single period point)
  - POST backfill (from, to, granularity, optional metrics) for historical recompute

Acceptance criteria
- Seed script creates 'ActivityStatistics' with required GSI.
- 'AppEventName' enum exported; docs published with event semantics and required properties.
- Aggregator jobs compute and persist daily/weekly metrics; idempotent by design.
- Admin endpoints return expected series/snapshots with pagination.
- Backfill endpoint recomputes requested ranges safely.
- Unit tests for calculators and repository; E2E flow test passes.

features.title: ActivityStatistics table and models (DynamoDB)
features.description:
Introduce a new DynamoDB table 'ActivityStatistics' to store aggregated metrics by period. Use BaseIdModel semantics (createdAt/updatedAt) and exclude dimensions/source_version. Provide models for reading/writing statistics.

Table schema (seed script):
- Attributes: id (S), metricKey (S), periodGranularity (S: 'daily'|'weekly'), periodStart (S ISO UTC), periodEnd (S ISO UTC), valueNumber (N), details (M), createdAt (S), updatedAt (S)
- PK: HASH id
- GSI: 'by-metricKey-periodStart' -> HASH metricKey, RANGE periodStart

Files to create/update:
- scripts/seed_database.sh (add 'ActivityStatistics' table + GSI)
- src/database/tables.ts (export const TABLE_ACTIVITY_STATISTICS = 'ActivityStatistics')
- src/models/statistics/ActivityStatisticModel.dto.ts (extends BaseIdModel; fields: metricKey, periodGranularity, periodStart, periodEnd, valueNumber?, details?)
- src/models/statistics/ActivityStatisticUpsertModel.dto.ts

features.title: ActivityStatistics repository and tokens
features.description:
Define repository interface and DynamoDB implementation for statistics operations (upsert, getSeries, getSnapshot). Use deterministic id '<metricKey>#<granularity>#<periodStartISO>' for idempotency. Provide tokens and module wiring.

Files to create:
- src/statistics/tokens.ts (export const ACTIVITY_STATISTICS_REPOSITORY)
- src/statistics/repositories/activity-statistics.repository.ts (interface)
- src/statistics/repositories/dynamodb-activity-statistics.repository.ts (extends BaseIdRepository)
- src/statistics/statistics.module.ts (providers wiring, import ScheduleModule.forRoot() if needed)

features.title: Aggregation jobs (daily/weekly) and calculators
features.description:
Implement a NestJS service that computes metrics from existing logs/tables and upserts to ActivityStatistics. Schedule daily (00:15 UTC) and weekly (Mon 01:00 UTC) jobs. Sessionization: new session after 30 minutes idle; prefer explicit session events.

Initial metrics (v1):
- Product engagement: dau, wau, sessions_per_user, avg_session_length, journal_prompt_accept_rate, nudge_open_rate, daily_action_completion_rate
- Voice journal: voice_recordings_count, avg_recording_length, dropoff_recording_rate, recording_completion_rate, journal_completion_rate
- Flow/drop-off: onboarding_completion_rate, prompt_accept_rate, prompt_ignore_rate
- Operational: wa_delivery_rate, wa_failed_rate, system_errors_count

Files to create:
- src/statistics/activity-statistics.aggregator.ts (service with @Cron jobs and calculators)
- src/statistics/sessionization.util.ts (per-user session reconstruction helper)

features.title: Event taxonomy and client enum for app logs
features.description:
Define and export an enum of supported app events so clients can use stable names when emitting app logs. Keep AppLogModel.eventName as string but recommend using the enum values.

features.title: Generic Funnels via flowIds
features.description:
Goal
Provide a generic, configurable funnel tracking mechanism tied to conversation flowIds and/or app events to compute drop-off and completion rates for key journeys (e.g., journalling when prompted, daily action completion, onboarding funnel).

Scope
- Funnel definition registry maps funnelId -> ordered steps and completion criteria.
- Steps can be defined as:
  - Conversation flow step reached (via ConversationsService storing flow progress), or
  - App event condition (e.g., PROMPT_SHOWN, JOURNAL_STARTED, DAILY_ACTION_COMPLETED), possibly with property filters.
- Storage: leverage existing raw sources (conversation logs and app logs). No new table in v1; aggregator computes daily/weekly funnel metrics and persists to ActivityStatistics.
- Metrics written:
  - funnel.<funnelId>.step_<n>_count (count of users reaching each step per period)
  - funnel.<funnelId>.completion_count (users completing final step)
  - funnel.<funnelId>.completion_rate (completion_count / step_1_count)
  - Optional: funnel.<funnelId>.dropoff_rate_by_step (in details map)
- Admin exposure: metrics become discoverable via existing admin statistics endpoints.

Integration points
- ConversationsService: hook when flows are stored (storeFlows) to emit or flag step completion (e.g., via a lightweight in-memory/on-the-fly join in aggregator that reads conversation logs by flowId per period). No synchronous side effects required.
- App events: use AppEventName.* names (e.g., PROMPT_SHOWN, PROMPT_ACCEPTED, DAILY_ACTION_SUGGESTED/COMPLETED) as step signals.

Examples to implement first
- funnel.journal_when_prompted: steps = [PROMPT_SHOWN] -> completion on JOURNAL_STARTED within same day; metric keys: funnel.journal_when_prompted.completion_rate, step_1_count, completion_count.
- funnel.daily_action_completion: steps = [DAILY_ACTION_SUGGESTED] -> completion on DAILY_ACTION_COMPLETED within same day; metric keys similar to above.
- funnel.onboarding_completion: steps = ordered onboarding flowIds culminating in ONBOARDING_COMPLETED; compute completion_rate and step counts.

Acceptance criteria
- Funnel registry defined and used by aggregator to compute period stats.
- At least the two example funnels (journal_when_prompted, daily_action_completion) computed daily; onboarding funnel computed daily.
- Metrics persisted with deterministic ids and returned via admin series/snapshot.
- Unit tests for the funnel step counting and completion-rate computation.

features.title: AudioRecordings table and lifecycle integration
features.description:
'Summary
Introduce a first-class AudioRecording entity/table, preserving the existing shape (including 'reference' and 'referenceId'), and integrate lifecycle state transitions across Journals and Goals. Continue to accept the 'audio_recording_session' app event for backward compatibility, but use the new table as the source of truth for session lifecycle and metadata.

Entity and model
- File: src/models/audio/AudioRecordingModel.dto.ts
- Extends: BaseIdModel (id, createdAt, updatedAt)
- Enums:
  - AudioRecordingState = { STARTED, SUBMITTED, STORED, TRANSCRIBED, COMPLETED, ERRORED }
  - AudioRecordingReference = { JOURNALS, GOALS }
- Fields (preserve exactly as currently defined in AppLogCreateModel):
  - userId: string (required)
  - state: AudioRecordingState
  - fileUrl?: string
  - transcription?: TranscriptionResultModel
  - reference?: AudioRecordingReference
  - referenceId?: string
  - error?: string
  - preErrorState?: AudioRecordingState
  - createdAtDate: string (YYYY-MM-DD)
- Validation/Swagger:
  - Use class-validator and class-transformer
  - Ensure 'transcription' uses TranscriptionResultModel with @ValidateNested() and @Type(() => TranscriptionResultModel)

DynamoDB table: 'AudioRecordings'
- Primary key: id (string)
- Attributes: id, userId, state, fileUrl, transcription, reference, referenceId, error, preErrorState, createdAt, updatedAt, createdAtDate
- Indexes:
  - GSI: 'by-user-id-createdAt' (HASH userId, RANGE createdAt, desc)
  - Optional GSIs (document only for now, not required v1):
    - 'by-reference-referenceId-createdAt' (HASH reference, RANGE referenceId#createdAt) for quick lookups by linked entity
- Seed script: update scripts/seed_database.sh to create the table and the 'by-user-id-createdAt' GSI

Repository & service
- Repository interface: src/audio-recordings/repositories/audio-recordings.repository.ts
  - create(recording: Partial<AudioRecordingModel> with required state STARTED and userId)
  - getWithId(id)
  - getForUser(userId, limit?, nextCursor?) via 'by-user-id-createdAt'
  - updatePartial(id, patch)
  - transitionState(id, newState, patch?) with validation of allowed transitions
  - setErrored(id, error) sets error + preErrorState (record last non-ERRORED state)
  - Ownership guard: updates require recording.userId to match caller
- DynamoDB impl: src/audio-recordings/repositories/dynamodb-audio-recordings.repository.ts
  - Extend BaseIdRepository; fill createdAtDate on create; support updatePartial; idempotent state transition (no downgrade)
- Service: src/audio-recordings/audio-recordings.service.ts
  - createStarted(userId, overrides?) -> recording
  - markSubmitted(id, patch?)
  - markStored(id, { fileUrl })
  - markTranscribed(id, { transcription })
  - markCompleted(id, refs?: { reference?: AudioRecordingReference; referenceId?: string })
  - setErrored(id, error)
  - Validate state machine: STARTED -> SUBMITTED -> STORED -> TRANSCRIBED -> COMPLETED; any -> ERRORED; idempotent transitions permitted

Integrations
- App logs ingestion (PUT /activity/app-log):
  - Keep accepting 'audio_recording_session' events.
  - When received with state STARTED, create or upsert a recording in 'AudioRecordings' (using provided id if present, else generate id). Store the same 'id' back to clients as 'sessionId' via AppLog response.
  - For subsequent 'audio_recording_session' updates with id, mirror into the table (transitionState + patch). App logs remain for observability.
- Goals: src/goals/goals.service.ts
  - At prepareMacroGoalFromAudio():
    - Transition to 'SUBMITTED' (file uploaded)
    - After S3 write: 'STORED' with fileUrl
    - After transcription: 'TRANSCRIBED' with transcription
    - After macro goal created/confirmed: 'COMPLETED'; set reference=GOALS, referenceId=goalId
    - On error: 'ERRORED' and preErrorState recorded
- Journals: src/journals/journals.service.ts
  - At prepareAudio(): same sequence as goals, but set reference=JOURNALS and referenceId=journalId upon completion
- Transcription (ai/transcription): when transcription finishes, call markTranscribed(id, { transcription }) on the service

Admin/visibility (optional v1)
- Admin debug endpoints to inspect recordings:
  - GET '/admin/users/:userId/audio-recordings' -> list (by-user-id-createdAt)
  - GET '/admin/audio-recordings/:id' -> fetch
  - PATCH '/admin/audio-recordings/:id' -> force state (debug only)

Backwards compatibility & migration
- Keep persisting 'properties.audioRecordingSession' in AppLogs for a transition period (analytics/observability remain unaffected) while the new table becomes the lifecycle source of truth.
- Prefer clients to rely on returned session id and not on app logs for session state in the future.

Acceptance criteria
- 'AudioRecordings' table and GSI created by seed script
- Model, repository, and service implemented; unit tests cover state transitions, idempotency, and error handling (preErrorState captured)
- 'prepareMacroGoalFromAudio' and 'prepareAudio' call the service to transition states at their checkpoints and populate reference/referenceId and fileUrl/transcription as appropriate
- App log ingestion updates are mirrored into the new table for 'audio_recording_session' events
- Ownership guard enforced for updates by id

Notes
- Preserve the 'reference' and 'referenceId' fields precisely as currently modeled; use them to link to the creating/consuming entity (JOURNALS/GOALS) for traceability.
- Ensure 'transcription' uses the existing TranscriptionResultModel; no shape changes.
'

features.title: Remove audio sessions from AppLogs and migrate voice metrics to AudioRecordingSessions (no backward compatibility)
features.description:
Summary
Eliminate audio recording session handling from AppLogs and switch all voice metrics to the new AudioRecordingSessions table. No backward compatibility: the 'audio_recording_session' app event is removed and rejected.

Scope
1) Remove audio sessions from AppLogs
- Remove AudioRecordingSession-related DTOs/types from: src/models/activity/AppLogCreateModel.dto.ts
- Remove AUDIO_RECORDING_SESSION from src/models/activity/AppEventName.enum.ts
- Update src/activity/activity.service.ts to remove any merge/update logic for 'audioRecordingSession'.
- In ingestion, if eventName == 'audio_recording_session', return 400 or 410 with an explanatory message (configurable; default 400).

2) Migrate voice metrics to AudioRecordingSessions
- Update statistics aggregator to compute voice metrics solely from AudioRecordingSessions:
  - voice.recordings_started: sessions with STARTED created in period
  - voice.recordings_completed: sessions transitioning to COMPLETED in period
  - voice.recordings_canceled: sessions transitioning to ERRORED in period
  - voice.completion_rate: completed/started
  - voice.dropoff_rate: errored/started
  - voice.avg_recording_length_seconds: derive if available, else 0 (documented)
- Remove dependence on VOICE_RECORDING_* AppLog events for these metrics.

3) Documentation
- Update event taxonomy docs: remove 'audio_recording_session' and instruct to use AudioRecordingSessions lifecycle.
- Update statistics docs to indicate new data source for voice metrics.

4) Tests
- Update aggregator unit tests to use synthetic AudioRecordingSessions data.
- Remove tests dependent on AppLogs for voice metrics or 'audio_recording_session' payloads.

5) Seed script
- No changes; ensure AudioRecordingSessions table exists per previous feature.

Acceptance criteria
- App logs ingestion rejects 'audio_recording_session'.
- AppLogCreateModel has no audioRecordingSession payload support.
- Voice metrics computed from AudioRecordingSessions only; all tests updated and passing.
- Docs updated accordingly.

Notes
- No backward compatibility retained. Clients must use AudioRecordingSessions service APIs to manage audio lifecycle.
